segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the final seat count and the go-live date so I can get the order form cleaned up today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 standard seats and 6 admin seats. That should cover the operations team plus the three managers starting next month.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 48 total. And you were still targeting May 20 for go-live, right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, May 20. We’d like training the week before, ideally May 14 or 15, two sessions if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I’ll hold May 14 at 10 a.m. Central and May 15 at 2 p.m. Central. On pricing, the annual total is $31,680, and implementation is the one-time $4,500 we discussed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Can you split the invoice so implementation is billed on signing and the subscription starts June 1?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. I’ll note subscription term June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, and the implementation invoice due net 30 from signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Legal also asked if the renewal notice can be 60 days instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that’s within our standard range. I’ll update the renewal notice to 60 days and send it through deal desk before I send the final copy.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you can get it over by tomorrow morning, I can route it for signature before our Friday cutoff.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the revised order form and invoice schedule by 10 a.m. Eastern tomorrow.
